file-input.Preloaded Single: React-only: reuses the Default/Multiple args and preloads files from a play function; the static markup is the same as the matching Default/Multiple story.
file-input.Preloaded Multiple: React-only: reuses the Default/Multiple args and preloads files from a play function; the static markup is the same as the matching Default/Multiple story.

file-list.No On Remove: The Django FileList is a static preview and always renders Delete buttons; React hides them when no onRemove is given.
file-list.Per File Override: React-only: demonstrates a per-row onRemove callback.

footer.Custom Composition: React-only: composes the footer from custom child elements, which the Django template does not accept.

header.Extensibility Slots: The Django story fetches theme-picker in the browser for navEndContent, so the static Django snapshot has no end slot.

in-page-nav.Custom Content Selector: React only: the Django template does not consume children, so a custom content region cannot be passed.
